yoke.definition: The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

younger.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youth’s.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zaire.definition: The unit of currency of Zaire from 1967 to 1998.

zebra.definition: Any of three species of subgenus Hippotigris: Equus grevyi, Equus quagga, or Equus zebra, all with black and white stripes and native to Africa.

zebras.definition: Any of three species of subgenus Hippotigris: Equus grevyi, Equus quagga, or Equus zebra, all with black and white stripes and native to Africa.

zenith.definition: The point in the sky vertically above a given position or observer; the point in the celestial sphere opposite the nadir.

zest.definition: The outer skin of a citrus fruit, used as a flavouring or garnish.

zigzag.definition: A line or path that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

zones.definition: Each of the five regions of the earth's surface into which it was divided by climatic differences, namely the torrid zone (between the tropics), two temperate zones (between the tropics and the polar circles), and two frigid zones (within the polar circles).

zoologist.definition: One who studies or practices zoology.

zoology.definition: The part of biology relating to the animal kingdom, including the structure, embryology, evolution, classification, habits, and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct.
